home.lead: Twinkle AI is a community focused on building open-source Traditional Chinese language models. We bring together passionate contributors to implement, share, and drive the adoption of AI technologies in Taiwan.

about.title: About Twinkle AI: Why Are We Doing This?
about.description: Building AI that speaks our language and understands our culture.
about.content:
AI is moving faster than a scooter weaving through Taipei traffic. While global models are incredibly powerful, they often feel disconnected from our daily lives—speaking to us in a way that’s technically correct but culturally distant. 

We believe Language is Life—it’s the soul of our identity. But without AI that understands our local nuance, the way we speak risks being washed away by generic data. At Twinkle AI, we’re here to bridge that gap. Since 2025, we’ve been curating local data and refining models with a single mission: to build an AI that actually "gets" us—one that feels natural, intuitive, and authentically local.

models.title: Training Traditional Chinese Models
models.description: We’re a bit obsessed with making AI that’s both smart and lightweight—because your hardware shouldn’t have to break a sweat just to understand the local culture.

items.title: T1 Model
items.description: A fine-tuned Gemma-3-4B built for precision reasoning. It masters local nuances to deliver natural, reliable dialogue without the generic fluff.

items.title: Formosa-1
items.description: The model that started it all. Based on Llama-3.2-3B, it sparked our early growth and proved that compact models can handle Traditional Chinese with a natural flow.

items.title: Twinkle Voice
items.description: A voice-first branch. Because sometimes, your hands deserve a break from typing.

datasets.title: Open Source Datasets
datasets.content:
Quality beats quantity, every time. Instead of chasing sheer volume, we focus on rigorous curation to ensure our data reflects how people in Taiwan truly speak.

By curating data from government open data, local community discussions, and Taiwanese literary archives, our pipeline filters out non-local idioms to keep the context accurate. In our world, it’s always '資訊', never '信息'—because asking for the 'Soccer' score in a London pub is a guaranteed way to lose the room.

eval.title: Evaluation & Benchmarking
eval.content: International benchmarks often miss the nuances of local life. We built our own ecosystem to bridge the gap between global AI and our actual lived experience.

items.title: Twinkle Eval
items.description: A dedicated utility for benchmark execution. Instead of hosting questions, it plugs models into localized datasets like TMMLU+ to automate testing and generate standardized logs.

items.title: Eval-analyzer
items.description: The diagnostic layer for Eval logs. It maps out where a model excels and where it trips up, pinpointing knowledge gaps for precise calibration.

items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: The public dashboard for Eval results. We turn raw data into clear rankings, making it easy to compare how models perform against local benchmarks at a glance.

teaser.title: Beyond the Models
teaser.description: Peek behind the scenes at the projects and people shaping our community.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content:
Twinkle AI started with a simple conviction: language is the heartbeat of culture. If future digital tools can't grasp the nuances of how we actually speak, our identity risks being diluted by one-size-fits-all algorithms.

Since early 2025, we’ve been curating local datasets and training models with one clear goal — to build an AI that truly 'gets' us and feels like a natural conversation partner.

story.title: How It All Started
story.content: We noticed that AI responses often feel disconnected, largely because they’re trained on an influx of external data that misses the local perspective. Whether it's legal nuances or cultural context, general-purpose models often miss the mark. That’s why we decided to start from the ground up, building the first Llama-based model specifically for Taiwan.

philosophy.title: Data Vetting & Linguistic Alignment
philosophy.content: We don’t just stockpile data; we curate it. Our focus is on data vetting and linguistic alignment. By sourcing from government records, community discourse, and literary archives, and applying automated filters to strip away non-local phrasing, we ensure our models learn from authentic Taiwanese context rather than generic linguistic imports.

vision.title: Formosa Vision
vision.content: In collaboration with the Taiwan Cultural Memory Bank, we are building vision datasets that teach AI to decode local cultural symbols — from historic trails and military villages to the landscapes of Matsu. It’s about teaching the model to see the world through a local lens

constellationProjects.title: Constellation Projects
constellationProjects.subtitle: Constellation Projects
constellationProjects.description: Rather than calling Twinkle AI a model developer, we are a group of technologists looking up at the same night sky. 'Building Taiwan's local open-source models' is our North Star, guiding developers scattered across different places. There is no rigid path here; each project is a constellation naturally connected during late-night Discord discussions. Here we align, adjust our coordinates, and turn distant imaginations into lines of working code. This section showcases the projects extended from the Twinkle AI community.

ailogora.title: AILogora
ailogora.creator: ChiChieh Huang
ailogora.story: AILogora and Twinkle AI are close allies with highly aligned visions. ChiChieh recognized early on the lack of spaces for in-depth AI academic and technical exchange, leading to the independent development of this platform. This matched our goals perfectly. Since joining forces, the high-density technical discussions within the Twinkle AI community have served as crucial knowledge nutrients for AILogora. Through this technology, our fleeting conversations are systematically 'distilled' and preserved, allowing these valuable technical assets to be easily searched and referenced, moving together toward building the largest AI knowledge base in the Traditional Chinese world.

littlestar.title: Little Star
littlestar.creator: Bobson Lin
littlestar.story: This experimental project started from a casual community discussion and pure curiosity, exploring: 'Can we run an LLM fully offline on a mobile device with low latency?' This experimental spirit led to the birth of the MVP, successfully running the F1 model smoothly on both iOS and Android. Through interactions with community members, Bobson noticed that besides running models, developers urgently needed benchmarks to measure performance. This key pivot evolved the project into a professional tool with benchmarking features. Currently, Little Star is moving toward 'Ambient Intelligence', bringing ubiquitous AI assistants directly to user devices.

aiyo.title: Aiyo Assistant
aiyo.creator: Chensi Studio
aiyo.story: Developed by Chensi Studio, the Aiyo AI chatbot is a dedicated assistant for people in Taiwan, built in long-term collaboration with Twinkle AI. Chensi integrated Twinkle AI's fine-tuned Traditional Chinese models in early experiments, helping drive Taiwanese LLM models from research to commercial applications. Primarily based on LINE for seamless integration with Taiwanese users' daily habits, Aiyo performs real-time searches across both internal and external networks, cross-referencing sources and filtering inappropriate content. It also features a custom news summarizer utilizing trusted sources, local arts and cultural event queries, and instant image recognition, bringing practical and reliable local info into a single conversation.

leopardcat.title: Mascot Leopard Cat
leopardcat.creator: Thomas
leopardcat.story: This unofficial proposal started during a Kaggle competition. Thomas initially designed a custom website to make the competition team stand out, proposing a powerful metaphor to community founder Liang-Hsun: 'In the era of API-driven apps, developers dedicated to training bottom-up open-source models are as rare and precious as the Taiwan Leopard Cat.' This resonance immediately sparked a connection, making the leopard cat the community's beloved mascot. Today, the mascot stands as the guardian of the community's late-night reading clubs ('Midnight Labs'), silently accompanying developers as they battle code in the early hours: 'On this rare path, we are never alone.'

website.title: Twinkle AI Website
website.creator: Taiwan Internet Technology Promotion Organization
website.positioning: Quiet Sky Hosting the Community's Heart
website.story: "The website itself has no story; its existence is to hold yours." To give the community's hard work a permanent home, Shiranui crafted this 'home.' Selecting deep night colors to let each star shine, the site is designed not as a display of technical showmanship, but as a gentle vessel, quietly standing watch in the distance so every contribution to Traditional Chinese AI can gather and shine.

hub.title: Twinkle Hub
hub.creator: Liang-Hsun Huang
hub.positioning: Powering AI with Taiwanese Open Data
hub.story: While the Taiwan government provides rich Open Data, the raw formats are scattered and unstructured, making it hard for AI to read directly. Twinkle Hub bridges this gap through data cleaning and standardization, transforming local public info into AI-friendly formats. Built on Anthropic's MCP (Model Context Protocol) architecture, it enables AI tools and agents to seamlessly read and analyze real-time local data, breaking down geographical information barriers.

costaff.title: CoStaff
costaff.creator: Simon Liu
costaff.story: Addressing the modern enterprise demand for efficiency, CoStaff builds 'plug-and-play' AI Staff. Moving beyond simple Q&A chatbots, it integrates deeply with daily business operations. By understanding complex workflows, CoStaff automates repetitive administrative, scheduling, and data consolidation tasks, allowing human team members to focus on high-value strategy and decision-making.

cairn.title: Cairn
cairn.creator: ChiChieh Huang
cairn.positioning: Shared Memory Layer for the AI Community
cairn.story: When working with agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini CLI, much of our learning happens in real-time workflows—debugging a bug, selecting an architecture, or logging an issue. However, these insights are often lost in chat logs, Discord threads, or personal notes. Cairn curates these community experiences into a shared knowledge map readable by both humans and AI agents. It preserves human context, judgment, and ownership while allowing agents to retrieve these insights via MCP, turning community experience into active context for the next developer's workspace.
